question: Which of the following states topped the medal tally in the Khelo India Youth Games 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra t**opped the medal tally **in the 2023 Khelo India Youth Games, with a total of 158 medals**
 
• Khelo India Youth Games:-__
 __
 
• It is a national-level multi-sport event for young athletes in India.
 
• In the 2023 games, Maharashtra won a total of 158 medals (including gold, silver, and bronze). 55 were silver out of those.
 
• Maharashtra's performance was boosted by strong showings in sports such as athletics, swimming, and wrestling.
 
• The state has consistently performed well in the Khelo India Youth Games, with a total of 307 medals won across all editions of the event so far.
 
• Other **States****​**
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**: Total 98 medals (38 Gold, 21 Silver, 39 Bronze)
 
• **Haryana**: Total 103 medals (35 Gold, 22 Silver, 46 Bronze)
 
• **Uttar Pradesh: **Total 42 medals(11 Gold,13 Silver,18 Bronze)
 
• **Punjab: **Total 39 medals(11 Gold, 13 Silver,15 Bronze)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Khelo India Youth Games:

__
 
• Earlier they are known as Khelo India School Games
 
• ​The second edition of Khelo India Youth Games was held in Pune.
 
• Maharashtra topped the Medal tally with 228 medals, whereas Haryana and Delhi claimed the second and third spot.
 
• Maharashtra bagged 'General Championship of Khelo India 2019' with 85 Gold Medals.
 
• Students from colleges and universities competed in the games.
 
• The 1st edition of Khelo India games was held in Delhi in January 2018.
 
• The Khelo India games are organised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports.
 
• 
 
3rd edition of the Khelo India Youth Games will be held at Guwahati from January 18-30, 2020.__ The Games will see a participation of more than 10,000 athletes and officials. It will be conducted in partnership with IOA, SGFI, and Assam as a host state.
